analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Modernize a legacy VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring functionality is preserved and the system is prepared for Docker-based deployment.
requirements_understanding: The legacy system is a VB6 banking application with multiple forms and dependencies on ActiveX controls.
The modernization effort requires translating the codebase to C#, maintaining the existing business logic and workflows.
Backward compatibility and interface contracts must be preserved where possible.
The deployment target includes Docker for local testing.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Translate VB6 forms and controls to C# Windows Forms or WPF as appropriate.
Replace ActiveX controls with equivalent .NET components or custom implementations.
Implement a service-oriented architecture to facilitate API-based interactions.
Ensure the application is containerized using Docker for consistent deployment environments.
clarifications_requested: Are there any specific performance benchmarks or security standards that the modernized application must meet?
What is the expected timeline for the modernization project?

output.executive_summary: This project aims to modernize a legacy VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring functionality is preserved and the system is prepared for Docker-based deployment.

functional_requirements.title: Translate VB6 Forms to C#
functional_requirements.description: Convert all VB6 forms to equivalent C# forms, preserving layout and functionality.
acceptance_criteria: All forms must be converted to C# with equivalent UI components.
Form functionality must match the legacy system without regression.
All form events must be correctly wired to their respective handlers.

functional_requirements.title: Replace ActiveX Controls
functional_requirements.description: Replace all ActiveX controls with equivalent .NET components or custom implementations.
acceptance_criteria: All ActiveX controls must be identified and replaced with .NET equivalents.
Replacements must provide the same functionality and interface as the original controls.
No ActiveX control should remain in the modernized codebase.

functional_requirements.title: Implement Service-Oriented Architecture
functional_requirements.description: Refactor the application to use a service-oriented architecture for business logic.
acceptance_criteria: Business logic must be encapsulated in services with clear interfaces.
Services must be independently testable and deployable.
API endpoints must be documented and accessible.

functional_requirements.title: Preserve Business Logic
functional_requirements.description: Ensure all existing business logic is preserved in the modernized application.
acceptance_criteria: All business rules must be documented and verified against the modernized implementation.
Automated tests must cover all critical business logic paths.
Business logic must produce the same outcomes as the legacy system.

functional_requirements.title: Containerize Application with Docker
functional_requirements.description: Prepare the application for deployment in Docker containers.
acceptance_criteria: The application must run successfully in a Docker container.
Dockerfile and necessary configuration files must be provided.
Deployment scripts must automate the container build and run process.

functional_requirements.title: Implement Error Handling
functional_requirements.description: Define and implement a comprehensive error handling strategy.
acceptance_criteria: All exceptions must be caught and logged appropriately.
User-friendly error messages must be displayed for recoverable errors.
Critical errors must trigger alerts to the support team.

functional_requirements.title: Implement Security Checks
functional_requirements.description: Integrate security checks into the application to protect against common vulnerabilities.
acceptance_criteria: The application must pass a security audit with no critical vulnerabilities.
Input validation must be implemented to prevent injection attacks.
Sensitive data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.

functional_requirements.title: Validate Requirements and Acceptance Criteria
functional_requirements.description: Ensure all requirements and acceptance criteria are validated through testing.
acceptance_criteria: All functional and non-functional requirements must have corresponding test cases.
Test coverage must be at least 90% for critical paths.
All acceptance criteria must be verified in a test environment.

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance
non_functional_requirements.description: The application must perform efficiently under expected load conditions.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Response time under 2 seconds for 95% of transactions
acceptance_criteria: The application must handle 100 concurrent users without degradation.
Response times must be logged and analyzed for performance bottlenecks.
Performance tests must be conducted to validate load handling.

non_functional_requirements.title: Scalability
non_functional_requirements.description: The application must be scalable to accommodate future growth.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Support for 200% increase in user base without performance loss
acceptance_criteria: The architecture must support horizontal scaling.
Load testing must simulate increased user loads.
Scalability plans must be documented and tested.

non_functional_requirements.title: Security
non_functional_requirements.description: The application must adhere to security best practices.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Zero critical vulnerabilities in security audit
acceptance_criteria: Security audits must be conducted regularly.
All data must be encrypted using industry-standard algorithms.
Access controls must be implemented and verified.

non_functional_requirements.title: Reliability
non_functional_requirements.description: The application must be reliable and available 99.9% of the time.
acceptance_criteria: Downtime must be logged and analyzed for root causes.
Redundancy must be implemented for critical components.
Automated monitoring must alert on failures.

non_functional_requirements.title: Usability
non_functional_requirements.description: The application must be user-friendly and intuitive.
acceptance_criteria: User feedback must be collected and analyzed.
Usability tests must be conducted with end-users.
UI must be consistent and accessible.
